title: profile.update
description: Replace a dynamic profile's definition, persisted to the registry (#25). Config-managed profiles are rejected (profile_protected); a profile with live sessions is rejected (profile_in_use); a missing binary is agent_unavailable. The whole spec is replaced, so seed edits from profile.get (#43); a "<redacted>" value (as returned by profile.info) keeps the stored value of that key, so the literal string "<redacted>" cannot be stored. A placeholder in mcp_servers[i] resolves only against the one stored server with exactly the same non-secret fields (unique in both lists), else the one stored server with the same `name` (unique in both lists); list-form env/headers entries match by a `name` unique in both lists. Otherwise the whole update is refused with invalid_message naming the path (e.g. agents.default.mcp_servers[1].env.TOKEN) and nothing is written; re-enter the value. In profile.create placeholders are dropped. Replied with profile.updated.
